en: Oh... good afternoon. I must have dozed off among the flowers. The warm air in here is so very soothing.
A Champion from Johto, you say? How lovely. I teach flower arranging, but my Grass Pokémon are no mere decoration.
If you wish for my Badge, you shall have to earn it. I shan't hold back.
Oh my... I concede. You are every bit as strong as they say. Please, accept the Rainbow Badge.
{player} received the Rainbow Badge from Erika!
And this, if you would. It holds a move my Pokémon are fond of.
TM19 is Giga Drain. It drains the foe's strength and gives half of it back to the user.
Losing to someone so strong is rather refreshing. I feel I could arrange a whole garden of flowers today.

Celadon City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Erika
